design: rho in (0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.85, 0.95) x L in (16, 32, 64), Laplace innovation, M = 512, 8 seeds; C in (1, 8) plus the LMMSE and isotropic oracles on the same held-out bundles; protocol ladder and validation selection; the crossover t_*(rho, L) is recorded per cell.
